alert: payments-api has started returning 503s on roughly 18% of requests, but all 12 pods are still Ready. Application traces show database operations sitting around 4.8s before a connection is assigned, while pgbouncer currently has 684 clients waiting for an available slot.

checkout-service 5xx responses have climbed to 27% while Redis requests are timing out and Postgres query latency has risen sharply. Redis timeout rate is around 19% and several database queries are now taking 4-7 seconds, so the symptoms are occurring across multiple dependencies at once.
